items.summary: Financial recommendation: retain only the bounded trainingsharks.com CLS repair and reject/defer both CRO experiments. Revenue support is weak: Amazon recorded $4.92 aggregate commission on 2026-09-21, with $0 site-attributed income; 6,219 clicks produced 28 ordered items and 6 shipped items, but the aggregate row cannot be assigned to sites. Portfolio outcomes remain inconclusive: 24 improvements await measurement, 33 requests failed, and 0 are proven. AI spend is measurable at $932.93 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-25 across 5,194 calls, but infrastructure, domain, labor, and other fixed costs are absent, so contribution margin, payback, cost-to-learn, and budget exposure are not calculable. The 0xroulette CTA lacks an activation baseline, and the allthingsmasonic experiment has 61 affiliate clicks but 0 orders and $0 commission; neither has sufficient financial evidence to justify additional implementation. Do not treat sessions, impressions, clicks, analytics conversions, opportunity scores, or GitHub popularity as revenue or margin evidence.
